page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor using the x86_64 architecture. It features 90 dedicated vCPUs derived from 45 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 720 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 3216 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across 8 local drives.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU, PassMark CPU, and software compilation tests scoring in the top 10% of all tested systems. Single-core performance is strong, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng and average for Geekbench. Memory read bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 6368.24 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 217.31 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, both ranking in the top 25%. However, large block memory write bandwidth and single-threaded decompression tasks perform in the average tier. Cryptographic capabilities are highly optimized, with PassMark encryption tests scoring in the top 10%, aided by hardware-accelerated instruction sets like AES and VAES.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a dense combination of high-capacity memory, dedicated compute cores, and fast local NVMe storage on a single node, reducing the need for distributed cluster overhead. It is designed for memory-intensive and I/O-heavy workloads. Appropriate applications include large-scale database operations, high-throughput Redis deployments, software compilation pipelines, and medium-scale language model prompt processing, where its local SSDs and high memory bandwidth can be fully utilized.
